title: Ancient Architects on the Giza water table

tellings.quote: So this is courtesy of Ancient Architects, another individual in the community who basically debunked debunked the study.

plain: A study about the water table under the Giza Plateau in Egypt was, according to a researcher named Jeffrey Drum, "basically debunked" by someone in the alternative-history community who goes by the name Ancient Architects. Drum tells Michels this while showing Ancient Architects' work, and he does not say which study it was or how it was answered. He brings it up as part of his case that a huge energy system lies beneath the pyramids.
